Excellent: Decision and requested action are explicit from the start
Acceptable: Decision is present but not consistently reinforced
Needs revision: Audience cannot tell what approval is requested

Excellent: Each slide advances one coherent argument with clear transitions
Acceptable: Sequence is understandable but contains repetition or weak transitions
Needs revision: Slides are a collection of related facts

Excellent: Claims are traceable and estimates assumptions and unknowns are visibly labelled
Acceptable: Most claims are responsible but some qualifications are weak
Needs revision: Unsupported claims or false commitments are presented as facts

Excellent: Every visual explains compares sequences or supports a claim
Acceptable: Most visuals are relevant but some are decorative or ambiguous
Needs revision: Visuals distract or imply unsupported certainty

Excellent: Major unknowns are paired with controls or validation steps
Acceptable: Unknowns are mentioned but controls are incomplete
Needs revision: Risks are hidden minimized or omitted

Excellent: Slides are concise and notes add accurate useful detail
Acceptable: Presentation is usable but text or notes need refinement
Needs revision: Slides are overcrowded or notes contradict the deck
